evidence: This is a wall face terrain strip (kind = terrain), which naturally presents as a vertical wall face spanning rows 0-31 with horizontal trim bands, bolted panels, a vent, and shelves.

style.evidence: The candidate wall is composed almost entirely of large flat fills of a single blue-grey colour (e.g., 12x12 pixel panels of one solid colour with only 4 corner rivet pixels, and solid dark blue-grey bands at the bottom). Unlike the Beodeul reference walls which have rich plaster speckling, multi-tone stone/brick work, and cast eave shadows, this candidate has no surface texture or grain and very low tile color density.
